unmappable_collision.why: The frozen runtime emits no structured discriminator between order-state and payment-state mutation. Parsing the request/answer text would introduce a heuristic category forbidden by this contract.

registry_joins.unknown_source_behavior: ADAPTER_UNKNOWN_SOURCE; never guess, use latest, or query a live registry.

null_semantics.entity_slot: Preserve null; missing keys are schema failures and must not be normalized to null.
null_semantics.quantity: null, zero, false, and an empty string remain distinct; zero is not a valid positive quantity.
null_semantics.collections: An empty list is preserved and is not equivalent to null or missing.
null_semantics.claim_evidence: Empty means no scorer-compatible observable claim provenance; it must not be filled from text, topic, or gold.

error_semantics.ADAPTER_MISSING_FIELD: Required observable input is absent; prediction is an evaluation-invalid record.
error_semantics.ADAPTER_UNKNOWN_ENUM: Runtime enum is outside the frozen map; prediction is an evaluation-invalid record.
error_semantics.ADAPTER_UNKNOWN_SOURCE: Source cannot be joined to the pinned registry; record fails closed without a guessed version.
error_semantics.ADAPTER_UNMAPPABLE_OUTCOME: Observable runtime state maps to more than one frozen outcome or to none; record is evaluation-invalid.
error_semantics.ADAPTER_INVALID_TYPE: Input type is not the declared type; record is evaluation-invalid.
error_semantics.ADAPTER_SCHEMA_FAILURE: Prediction cannot satisfy the scorer schema; record is evaluation-invalid.

claim_evidence_safety.consequence: Applicable claim-support credit cannot be perfect; the required perfect synthetic pipeline mirror cannot be constructed from the frozen real runtime contract.
